notes: Ludum Dare 39 jam game Lumière by Josh Shepherd / JoshLmao (https://joshlmao.itch.io/lumiere). Complete Unity 5.6.0f3 project with playable Assets/scenes/level.unity in EditorBuildSettings. MIT at the repo-root LICENSE (Copyright 2017 Josh Shepherd). Author states this was made fully by himself for the jam; art includes original PSD sources, and short PCM SFX have no third-party tags. Bundled font Open Sans Light (Apache License 2.0; digitized data copyright 2010-2011 Google Corporation / Ascender Corporation) at src/Lumiere/Assets/fonts/OpenSansLight.ttf. The Unity-Technologies/PostProcessing submodule listed in upstream .gitmodules was not vendored (empty checkout) and is omitted together with PostProcessing.meta. No DOTween, no EmojiOne, no FXAA, no Unity Standard Assets, no Asset Store packages, no LFS, no DLL. ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt is retained. Unity project lives under src/Lumiere/.
